daily_scan.notes: Friday scan. Code harvest surfaced ~19 code-pattern strings (PT403/PT404, GB-7001, IVL3021/3024, AUL009, MET-233i, ABBV-295, ZP8396, HM15275, AMG133/MariTide, NN1213, CT-G32, DD14/DD07/DD02S/DD03/MET06, DD15) -- all resolved to already-tracked aliases or known decoys except DD15 (D&D Pharmatech's Metsera-licensed injectable GLP-1/GIP/GCG triple agonist, 'Tri-G'), which was unknown and used this run's one bounded code query; resolved into a new candidate (cand-2026-10-02-001) rather than a known program. Rotation list: queried ct-g32, abbv-295, pt404 and lilly-camurus (4 rows, resuming after 'biote-cn121154792a' and wrapping to the start) -- all four reconfirmed existing documentation with nothing new; repeating the standing proposal that the admin remove 'abbv-295' and 'biote-cn121154792a' from the rotation list now that both are tracked candidates. One existing ready_for_promotion candidate's UniSphero/Samik Pharmaceutical thymosin alpha-1 patent (cand-2026-09-17-001) resurfaced via a B1 cross-class query but matched evidence already on file (patent No. 10-3012843) -- no new append. B3 cheap pass (2/2 searches spent): re-searched the 2 near_bar candidates furthest from their last check, i2o Therapeutics (cand-2026-09-20-002) and Precision Antibiotics (cand-2026-09-07-001) -- both found only material already on file, no new dated event for either, promotion_bar.evidence rewritten on both, no status change. Date math aged all 17 unresolved candidates (16 carried in plus the new DD15 candidate). Stall rule applied for the first time this registry has triggered it: cand-2026-09-02-002 (Samchundang) and cand-2026-09-02-003 (SpiderCore) both reached 30+ days with 6-7 follow-up checks and no evidence dated after their own creation date, so both moved pending -> stalled, flagged recommend reject-or-snooze.
